{{Quote|Captain, this is Curske. She's going to help you get inside the museum.|Sumalee|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Curske''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] living on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], Curske fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] together with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sumalee]] from a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base in the [[Axial Park]]. On Sumalee's request, she provided a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as the [[Voidhound]] with maps of Selonian tunnels leading to the [[Museum of Alien History]], an Imperial-occupied building where the traitorous [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] was being held.
